name: Easy Prey adds one second to Hemostasis (#958)
contract: Easy Prey 704621 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000 ms, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 8) = word 2 bit 3 = Hemostasis 681304 (the ability), Hemostasis 302895 (the re-activation window) and Blood Burst 803326. Both Hemostasis records have DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, and Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION. AscensionBloodmageHemostasis.cpp drives the window with AddAura/RemoveAurasDueToSpell and never overrides a duration, so it does not bypass the modifier. Tooltip: "Increases the duration of Hemostasis by $/1000;s1 sec." Regression guard for native behaviour.
